title: SteamPunk Unlimited
description:
SteamPunk Unlimited is an ultimate 1.20.1 Steampunk modpack focused on engineering and exploration.
Build massive factories, trains, and diesel generators and much more!
body:
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/104716cea1c079a1fcd47f4b4b1ad69db14cc2bc_0.webp)

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5972af026d78c57c43d2ee1b94ec4bb911f32003.png)

⚙️ Ultimate Steampunk Experience powered by Create & massive Addons


⚙️ True Physics Airships — Build and fly your own ships with Valkyrien Skies & Eureka


⚙️ Advanced Modular Warfare — Customize every tool and weapon with Tetra & Art of Forging


⚙️ Cinematic Combat — Experience fluid, tactical fights with Better Combat integration


⚙️ Interstellar Travel — Build rockets and colonize 5+ planets with Ad Astra


⚙️ Epic World Generation — Stunning biomes from Biomes O' Plenty & Tectonic


⚙️ Legendary Bosses — Face terrifying encounters from L_Enders_Cataclysm


⚙️ Massive Structure Overhaul — Explore YUNG’s reworked world & IDAS dungeons


⚙️ Hardcore Survival — Master the elements with Cold Sweat temperature mechanics


⚙️ Industrial Logistics — Trains, Diesel Generators, and Automation at your fingertips


⚙️ Steam-Powered Arsenal — Heavy cannons, jetpacks, and advanced steampunk gadgets


⚙️ Full Optimization — Maximum FPS with Embeddium, ModernFix, and FerriteCore
